in_sanskrit.name: सुवान्कर
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: सु (su) meaning good, auspicious, prosperous, वान् (vān) meaning vehicle, कर (kar) meaning doing. Thus, Suvankar means one who does good and auspicious deeds, one who is victorious and prosperous.

in_marathi.name: Suvankar
in_marathi.long_meaning: Suvankar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'su' meaning good and 'vankar' meaning conqueror or victorious. It symbolizes the strength and intelligence of a person who is able to overcome obstacles in life.
